rationale: Best-supported negative because the text describes a conventional data-structure language and serialization standard, not AI functionality. evidence_spans: Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN. 1) is a standard interface description language (IDL) for defining data structures that can be serialized and deserialized in a cross-platform way.
conflict_response: The description identifies ASN.1 as a language/standard and explains its data-structure and serialization purpose, but does not identify an executable software offering.
